column1: Since you're interested in the position, you briefly consider pulling the memo down before anybody else can apply. But you're too much of a straight-shooter to resort to such underhanded tactics...for now.
column2: 既然你對這個職缺有興趣，你短暫考慮過在別人申請前把備忘錄取下。但你太正直了，暫時還不會使這種卑鄙手段……

column1: Hey, Sonny, I saw the write-up in the paper. I suppose your head's gonna swell. Don't forget, you've gotta fit it in the door of the Blue Room for Jack's surprise party tonight. See ya!
column2: 嘿，Sonny，我在報紙上看到你的報導了。你大概快得意忘形了。別忘了今晚得準時到 Blue Room 參加 Jack 的驚喜派對。回頭見！

column1: How's it goin', Sonny? I'd like to shoot the bull, but Dooley's gonna deep-fry my huevos if I'm late for one more briefing this week. Later, hot shot.
column2: 最近如何，Sonny？我本想和你閒聊，但這週再遲到一次簡報，Dooley 就要把我的蛋蛋炸熟了。待會見，明星！

column1: Most disturbing, perhaps, is Lytton's newest nemesis; the drug trade. The problem no longer consists of kids buying marijuana from each other in the park. The amount of drug-related violence has almost doubled in the past five years. There have been recent rumors about a ruthless drug lord, known as the Death Angel.
column2: 最令人不安的，也許是 Lytton 最新的敵人：毒品交易。問題已不只是孩子們在公園互相買賣大麻。過去五年，毒品相關暴力幾乎增加了一倍。最近還流傳著一名冷酷毒梟的傳聞，人稱「死亡天使」。

column1: Don't get us in trouble, man! If Dooley thinks we're goofin' off, he'll kick our butts.
column2: 別害我們惹上麻煩！要是 Dooley 覺得我們在混日子，他會把我們的屁股踢爛。

column1: You'd better sit down and get ready for the briefing. You can read your mail later.
column2: 你最好坐下準備簡報。郵件晚點再看。

column1: Sgt. Dooley stands here when he briefs the 1300 shift.
column2: Dooley 警佐在這裡向 1300 班次進行簡報。

column1: Sgt. Dooley isn't in the mood to chat right now. Best to get out of his way.
column2: Dooley 警佐現在沒心情聊天。最好別擋他的路。

column1: BONDS! How many times do I hafta tell you...GET TO THAT BRIEFING! GO! NOW! MOVE IT!
column2: BONDS！我到底要說幾次……去參加簡報！現在就去！快動！

column1: Whatever it is, Bonds, I don't wanna hear it. In case you forgot, we've got a BRIEFING to attend this morning. So if it isn't too much trouble...
column2: 不管是什麼，Bonds，我都不想聽。提醒你一下，我們早上要參加簡報。要是你不嫌麻煩的話……

column1: Sgt. Dooley isn't in the mood to chat right now. Best to get out of his way.
column2: Dooley 警佐現在沒心情聊天。最好別擋他的路。

column1: BONDS! In case you hadn't heard, you've got a BRIEFING to attend in a few minutes. So do us all a favor and get out of your pajamas before the briefing starts.
column2: BONDS！你可能還沒聽說，再過幾分鐘就要參加簡報。幫大家一個忙，在簡報開始前把睡衣換掉。

column1: Sgt. Dooley's desk looks like it was hit by a tornado.
column2: Dooley 警佐的桌子像被龍捲風襲擊過。

column1: You take the memo from Sgt. Dooley. Being one-on-one with him in this mess makes you doubly uncomfortable; you decide to read the memo quickly and get on with it.
column2: 你從 Dooley 警佐手中接過備忘錄。在這片混亂中和他單獨相處讓你格外不自在；你決定趕快讀完備忘錄，繼續辦事。

column1: Wha-?! You bonehead! You put that little chemical weapon back on my desk! Get out of here! I'm glad you're going to Narcotics! Let Morgan put up with you for awhile! Get out of here, Bonds! BEAT IT!
column2: 什麼？！你這笨蛋！你把那件小型化學武器放回我的桌上了！滾出去！我很高興你要去緝毒組！讓 Morgan 忍受你一陣子吧！滾出去，Bonds！快滾！

column1: Ah Bonds, so good of you to take a little time out of your "busy" schedule to drop by. Well, it looks like you got what you wanted. A memo just came down from Morgan's office. It says here--
column2: 啊，Bonds，真難得你能從「忙碌」的行程中抽空過來。看來你如願以償了。Morgan 辦公室剛送來一份備忘錄，上面寫著——

column1: Here, you take it. Read it yourself, I hope you choke on it! As soon as you're done, put on your plainclothes and get to Morgan's office. I don't want to look at you any more! Oh, man, my whole head is leaking!
column2: 拿去，你自己讀。我希望你讀到噎住！讀完後立刻換便服，去 Morgan 的辦公室。我不想再看到你！天啊，我的腦袋都快漏光了！

column1: Do you want to see the other piece of evidence, Sonny?
column2: Sonny，你要看看另一件證物嗎？

column1: It's Detective Laura Watts, your new partner in the Narcotics department.
column2: 這是 Laura Watts 警探，你在緝毒組的新搭檔。

column1: Hello, Laura.
column2: 你好，Laura。

column1: Lt. Morgan seems glad to see you.
column2: Morgan 中尉似乎很高興見到你。

column1: Lt. Morgan, it's a pleasure to be on this assignment.
column2: Morgan 中尉，很高興能參與這項任務。

column1: I'm afraid I have some terrible news. Officer Jack Cobb's daughter Kathy died in the hospital about an hour ago. Apparently she never woke up.
column2: 恐怕我有個壞消息。警員 Jack Cobb 的女兒 Kathy 約一小時前在醫院去世了。她似乎一直沒有醒來。

column1: My God...thank you, Sgt. Dooley. I appreciate your letting me know. You've spoken to Jack, yes?
column2: 我的天……謝謝你，Dooley 警佐。謝謝你告訴我。你已經和 Jack 談過了，對吧？

column1: Thank you, sir. I'm happy to be here.
column2: 謝謝長官。我很高興能來這裡。

column1: Sonny, now let's not go touching my plaques and awards, okay? Thank you. Now, let's both get to our jobs, alright? All right.
column2: Sonny，別碰我的獎牌和獎狀，好嗎？謝謝。現在我們都去做自己的工作，好嗎？就這樣。

column1: Sonny, what are you waiting for? Get to the Evidence Room immediately!
column2: Sonny，你還在等什麼？立刻去證物室！

column1: 7. Jason Taselli Sex:M 6'0" Hair:Blk Eyes:Blue Wt:190 Distinguishing Marks: Rose Tattoo over left nipple.
column2: 7. Jason Taselli 性別：男 身高：6 呎 頭髮：黑 眼睛：藍 體重：190 磅 特徵：左乳頭上有玫瑰刺青。

column1: The rose tattoo! Hoffman and Taselli are almost certainly the same man. You take the list from the clipboard.
column2: 玫瑰刺青！Hoffman 和 Taselli 幾乎可以確定是同一個人。你從夾板上取下名單。

column1: You take the wanted poster of Taselli from the clipboard.
column2: 你從夾板上取下 Taselli 的通緝海報。

column1: Sonny! Just the man I wanted to see! Did you get the warrant?
column2: Sonny！我正要找你！你拿到拘票了嗎？

column1: DAMN! How did that happen? Oh, hell, we don't have time to worry about that now. We have a tip that a drug buy is about to go down in Bert's Park. Let's go, Sonny!
column2: 該死！怎麼會這樣？算了，我們沒時間操心了。我們收到線報，Bert 公園即將進行毒品交易。走吧，Sonny！

column1: There you are Sonny. I came by to tell you that when you're done checking out the case evidence, Lt. Morgan wants to see you.
column2: 你在這裡啊，Sonny。我來告訴你，檢查完案件證物後，Morgan 中尉要見你。

column1: There you are, Sonny. Did you get the No Bail Warrant?
column2: 你在這裡啊，Sonny。你拿到不得交保拘票了嗎？

column1: I sure did. Hoffman's not going anywhere.
column2: 當然拿到了。Hoffman 哪裡也跑不了。

column1: Good job! We don't have time to rest on our laurels now, though. We just got in a call. One of our informants just let us know about an impending drug bust in Bert's Park. Let's roll, partner!
column2: 做得好！但現在沒時間休息。我們剛接到通報。有線人告知 Bert 公園即將進行毒品交易。出發吧，搭檔！

column1: You look through Hoffman's file.
column2: 你翻閱 Hoffman 的檔案。

column1: You pick up the freshly-printed Wanted poster of Jason Taselli and take it with you.
column2: 你拿起剛印好的 Jason Taselli 通緝海報，帶在身上。

column1: You take the black book.
column2: 你拿起黑色筆記本。

column1: Flipping through the book, you see many notes and entries. You decide to wait and examine it more thoroughly after it's been booked into evidence. You put it back in the glove box.
column2: 你翻閱筆記本，看見許多筆記與紀錄。你決定等它登記為證物後再仔細檢查，於是把它放回手套箱。

column1: Officer Bonds, this is Lt. Hamilton. I have an ID on that 11-44. He was a low-level drug dealer named Lenny Warren. Just as we suspected, he was killed by a bullet to the brain. I thought you'd be interested to find out. If you hear anything that might be pertinent, let me know immediately.
column2: Bonds 警員，我是 Hamilton 中尉。我查出那名 11-44 的身分了。他是個叫 Lenny Warren 的低階毒販。正如我們猜測的，他死於腦部中彈。我想你會想知道。若聽到任何相關消息，立刻通知我。

column1: Yes, sir, I will. And thank you, Lieutenant Hamilton. I appreciate your passing that information along.
column2: 是，長官，我會的。謝謝你，Hamilton 中尉。感謝你提供這項資訊。

column1: I calls 'em as I sees 'em, Bonds. Well, we better split, huh? And don't forget Jack's party tonight at the Blue Room, Sonny-boy.
column2: 我只是照我看到的說，Bonds。好了，我們最好分頭行動，嗯？別忘了今晚在 Blue Room 的 Jack 派對，Sonny 小子。

column1: At last, Officer Jack Cobb arrives. You've never been so glad to see him in your life!
column2: 終於，Jack Cobb 警員到了。你這輩子從沒這麼高興見到他！

column1: You hand the gun to Jack.
column2: 你把槍交給 Jack。

column1: Well handled, Sonny. Give me that piece and I'll take care of booking it into evidence while you search the vehicle.
column2: 處理得好，Sonny。把那把槍給我；你搜查車輛時，我會負責把它登記為證物。

column1: Good job, Sonny. See you back at the station.
column2: 做得好，Sonny。警局見。

column1: Thanks, Jack. And thanks for getting here so fast.
column2: 謝謝你，Jack。也謝謝你這麼快趕到。

column1: XXX YOU PULL OVER THE STOLEN CAR SUSPECT, CALL AND WAIT FOR BACKUP, ARREST PERP, INSPECT CAR AND EVIDENCE AND THEN HEAD FOR JAIL TO BOOK SUSPECT.
column2: XXX 你攔下偷車嫌犯，呼叫並等待支援，逮捕嫌犯，檢查車輛與證物，然後前往監獄登記嫌犯。

column1: Victor, how long have you been taking drugs?
column2: Victor，你吸毒多久了？

column1: Did you hear that, Sonny? This is the barfbag who's been dealing to Jack's daughter! He'll be delighted to hear this creep is off the streets.
column2: 你聽到了嗎，Sonny？這就是販毒給 Jack 女兒的垃圾！知道這個混蛋不能再危害街頭，他一定會很高興。
